title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: coap_location.c::sensors_location_post not refactored for OSCORE
description: sensors_location_post at coap_location.c:85 uses bare lichen_coap_is_local_admin() without refactoring to coap_oscore_authorize_mutating(). This prevents OSCORE-authenticated mesh peers from posting location updates.
